definitions.adr159_outcome: auto_allow_eligible | already allowed | recorded deny | not yet reviewed
definitions.degree: distinct claim subjects whose claims reference the org via object_entity (the K2 organisation-edge measure — NEW-1 re-measured, never pinned)
definitions.edge_share: degree / the flagged-org graph's distinct (subject, org) pairs (the denominator this report prints)
definitions.identifiers: external entity_identifier scheme:value pairs held; label-bearing schemes (*.name, sig.curator.handle, …) are counted in label_identifier_count, never listed
definitions.materialized_degree: live incident edges over relationship + entity_role + organization_relation (open sys_period where bitemporal)
definitions.person_name_screen: policy.intake.screen_part_viii + the partner_identity never-a-person rule over cached_canonical_name + literal party claim values — result only, screened text never recorded
definitions.registry_match: an entity_identifier in an ADR-159 registry scheme whose asserting claim reaches an ingestion_permitted source (tier-0 match record)
